label: Volume share
definition: Share of UWWTP's wastewater discharged via this discharge point (%)

label: Less sensitive area code
definition: code of less sensitive area according to Article 6(2) or 6(4). If a list of less sensitive areas is not being compiled, only the code for the type of less sensitive area can be provided (e.g. lsa according to Article 6(2), where the deadline for 2T is 2037 or 6(4), where the deadline is 2045. Article 6(2); Article 6(4).

label: Nutrient sensitive area code
definition: link to nutrient sensitive area spatial delineation. Article 7.

label: Micropollutant risk area code
definition: link to the spatial delineation of areas where the concentration or the accumulation of micropollutants represents a risk for the environment or human health SAnutrient / SAmicropollutant. Article 8.

label: Receiving area type
definition: Type of water body (receiving environment) into which wastewater is discharged.

label: Water body code
definition: Code of the receiving water body. Idea, to be confirmed.

label: Sensitive area code
definition: Code of the sensitive area. Idea, to be confirmed.
